function.description: Internal low-level record lookup. Returns one stored record identified by its UUID (the `id` parameter). Use only when an upstream step has already produced a specific record UUID and you need to fetch that exact row. Not used to answer user-facing questions; for any user question about a device, route to a device-level or assurance-level tool instead.
function.name: api_getNetworkDeviceConfigurationFileDetails

fileType.description: Internal enum filter. Allowed values: RUNNINGCONFIG, STARTUPCONFIG, VLAN.

id.description: UUID of the stored record to retrieve.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

networkDeviceId.description: Optional UUID filter for the owning device. Maximum 5 values.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

createdBy.description: The entity responsible for creating the configuration changes.

createdTime.description: The UNIX epoch timestamp in milliseconds marking when the resource was created.

fileType.description: Type of configuration file. Config File Type can be 'RUNNINGCONFIG' or 'STARTUPCONFIG' or 'VLAN'.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the configuration file.

networkDeviceId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the network devices.

versionId.description: The version unique identifier triggered after any config change.
